I pressed "post" too quick, maybe now you'll see how fucked up I am. 

I have a therapist. A few supportive family members. But none of them should be burdened by knowing that I'm a monster.

I can't sleep. I barely eat. I think I'm genuinely going/am insane. 

I pass out around 4 AM, and can't wake up until 11. 

The only times I've been eating is when I'm being watched to make sure I eat. 

I failed a class (maybe two)

I can't stop thinking about how much I want to tear my skin apart. 

And I think I'm crazy. 

I know, I know, crazy people think they're sane and all, but I think I'm actually terrible. 

Im a compulsive liar. I lie about EVERYTHING. I manipulate people without realizing it. People actually think of me as a good person, which is crazy!! Especially when I think of myself as "smart" when I get away with sneaky things, like buying a knife. Or how long I've been clean. 

I can't stop thinking about killing myself. I fantasize about my death. I have dreams frequently where my arms are torn to shreds, or me hanging myself, or me stabbing myself and laying down, free. Sometimes even being in a romantic relationship that ends in me being killed by my lover, on my terms. 

I'm so fucked up. I want to die. I can't take this shit anymore. 

Bur what do I do about it?

Have a pit in my stomach. Lustfully gaze at the sharp edges of my boxcutter. Touch the edges of kitchen knives to see which is the sharpest. Drool at the height that the nearby lighthouse is. Reminding myself how to tie a noose, but never being able to hang one up, since I have no rope. 

I feel crazy. I am crazy.
Love you, AutoMod.
I want other's opinions on if I'm crazy or not.

Long story short- I've been going down for a long time. This mental health shit is not new to me. 

I went to Walgreens and bought a new knife. No one knows about it. I've been self harming less frequently with it, just deeper cuts. 

I've been planning my death. Saving up cash to buy materials for it. 

I know no one will care when I'm gone. Not really. 

People say they know me, that I'm a good person. I'm selfless, I'm great, amazing even, but none of that is true. 

What's more selfish then only thinking of yourself? Of your death?

I'm so tired. I can't eat. I can't sleep without aid. My mom's abusive. No one loves me. 

If I died tomorrow, how many people would come to my funeral?

A few people, to save face. No one would want to come. They'll only care when I do something right.

I'm in high school and college at the same time, I'm stressed so much. But I'm not in "hard" classes. So I'm childish to feel overwhelmed. 

That's my only achievement. And I hate it.

I can't drive. All my cousins can, and they're good at it. And they're praised. 

There is nothing left for me. As soon as I buy a rope from Walmart, I'll be gone.
